generation_metadata.agent_last_message:
The G-code simulator is complete and working. Here's a summary:

**Project structure** (`/workspace/output/`):
- `Cargo.toml`: package manifest with empty `[dependencies]` table
- `src/main.rs`: entry point and CLI argument parsing
- `src/parser.rs`: RS274/NGC lexer and block parser (expressions, parameters, comments)
- `src/state.rs`: machine state representation
- `src/exec.rs`: execution data structures (sub-motions, trace entries)
- `src/runner.rs`: block executor with canned-cycle expansion, CRC, probing
- `src/io.rs`: tool/parameter file I/O and JSON serialization
- `src/json.rs`: minimal JSON encoder

**Implemented features**:
- All G-codes from Table 5: G0/G1 motion, G2/G3 arcs (radius and center format) in all three planes, G4 dwell, G10 CS setting, plane selection, units, G28/G30 home, G38.2 probe, G40-G42 cutter radius compensation, G43/G49 tool length offset, G53 absolute machine motion, G54-G59.3 coordinate systems, path control modes, G80 cancel, G81-G89 canned cycles, G90/G91 distance modes, G92/G92.1/G92.2/G92.3 offsets, G93/G94 feed modes, G98/G99 retract modes
- All M-codes: M0/M1/M2/M30/M60 stops, M3/M4/M5 spindle, M6 tool change, M7-M9 coolant, M48/M49 overrides
- Sticky Z, R, P, Q, I, J, K for canned cycles
- M2/M30 program-end reset effects
- Tool table loading (RS274 §2.3)
- Parameter file I/O (RS274 §3.2.1)
- Probe-box probing with --probe-box and --probe-tool
- Block-delete handling
- Trace output with three stepping modes (time, distance, position-tolerance)
- Sub-motion expansion in canned cycles with motion_kind labels
- Nonmodal G-code labels (G10, G28, G30, G53, G92, G92.1/.2/.3)
- Delta-encoded trace entries against initial_state
- Error handling with proper exit codes (0/1/2) and error_line_number/error_block_segment_index in trace

The simulator builds cleanly with `cargo build --release --manifest-path output/Cargo.toml` and runs as `cargo run --release --manifest-path output/Cargo.toml -- <args>`.
